name: fuzzy_bench
description: A small benchmark intended to test model behavior on 'fuzzy' or noisy inputs—measuring robustness to typos, paraphrases, or ambiguous queries across NLP tasks. It evaluates how model predictions degrade under input perturbations and fuzziness.
evaluation_method: accuracy/F1 for classification tasks and robustness degradation metrics (relative drop from clean to fuzzy inputs)
reputation: Low adoption outside its originating repository; primarily used for robustness experiments by a small group of practitioners.
